note: What a server sends to change the state of an inhibitor, and say how long the new state lasts. The header names the unit this is about.

bits.name: duration
bits.note: How long the state lasts, in seconds; zero where alive is set.

bits.name: alive
bits.note: Set while the inhibitor stands, with duration zero; clear while a state lasts the duration given.

fields.name: state
fields.note: Which state. A server sends 0 as the inhibitor falls.

fields.name: duration
fields.note: How long the state lasts. Unit undetermined; a server sends 300.
